svg.title: ARIA Behavior Model — How pattern learning works
svg.desc: Detail diagram showing how ARIA's behavior model learns user rhythms, transitions, and workload state from raw event sequences.
svg.text: Click any component to learn more

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What raw events does the behavior model consume?')
sendPrompt('How does the temporal rhythm model work in ARIA?')
sendPrompt('How does ARIA model activity transitions?')
sendPrompt('How does ARIA measure cognitive load and workload?')
sendPrompt('How does ARIA merge multiple behavioral signals into a context vector?')
g.text: User state embedding: [hour, day, workload, predicted_next_activity, open_tasks, deadline_pressure]

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What predictions does ARIA make from the context vector?')
sendPrompt('How does ARIA rank suggestions for urgency?')
sendPrompt('How does ARIA know when NOT to interrupt the user?')

svg.text: Key distinction: not keyword matching — learned probability distributions over user-specific temporal sequences
